title: Local Government Resolution Of May And Dyarchy
definition: The 1882 Resolution on Local Self-Government (Lord Ripon) aimed to decentralize administration by creating local boards, while Dyarchy (introduced by the Government of India Act 1919) established a dual system of government in provinces, transferring 'Local Self-Government' to Indian ministers.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is critical for understanding the evolution of administrative decentralization, the transition from colonial autocracy to representative government, and the constitutional history of India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Local Government Resolution Of May And Dyarchy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
